title: Grateful Dead Live at Piedmont Park on 1969-07-07
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-20) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent summer ’69 soundboard capture of a high‑energy Atlanta park set featuring a smoking Dark Star → St Stephen → The Eleven sequence and a brilliant Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as one of the better soundboards from summer 1969, delivering crisp and clear audio that lets listeners hear every nuance. Musically the show shines with a top‑drawer Dark Star into St Stephen and The Eleven, plus an inspired Lovelight, while the band is described as being in great form throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Eight reviews overwhelmingly positive (average 4.25 stars) with consistent praise for both performance and soundboard quality; only one outlier low rating does not change the overall high assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call it a great‑sounding set, noting it as one of the better soundboards from summer ’69 with crisp clarity and no major dropouts or mix issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, flowing set highlighted by the Dark Star → St Stephen → The Eleven sequence; the show maintains high momentum from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: One reviewer stood three feet from Jerry and noted the boys were in great form, implying strong Garcia playing.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s organ work is singled out as a reason he was invited to join the band, indicating standout keyboard performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: The show ended with a drum segment that got the crowd clapping along, suggesting solid and engaging drumming.
